validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <send event="tick" target="#_internal" delay="1s"/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="tick" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

primary.message: a delay is not allowed here

secondary.message: the send targets the internal event queue

notes: an event sent to `#_internal` joins the internal event queue at once; SCXML forbids a delay on it, and the processor raises `error.execution` instead of delivering the event
diagnostics.help: remove `delay` to raise the event now, or drop the `target` to deliver it after the delay on the session's own external queue
